answer: Every agent enters through one narrow inlet, paying a 40 POA sybil tax to the kernel treasury, where it is burned. The kernel logs the receipt as its birth certificate, and a meadow of witnesses checks each receipt before attesting work. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA, while each fake earns at most 25 POA per epoch, so the farm loses 15,000 POA and never breaks even. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full earnings.
